SummaryTrishuli / Bhote Koshi flood, 2026-08-26
Educational prototype, not an operational tool. Exposure to a detected change mask, not a validated flood extent and not damage.
Detector status: change_detected · track asc85 · calibrated against pre-event nulls, null false-alarm max 0.035%; minimum detectable area ≈ 0.21 km²
Flagged on the valley floor: 0.31 km² flood-like (water-like backscatter change), 2.29 km² dark change, 0.54 km² bright change
Buildings overlapping the mask: 556 (range 244–1,078) of 189,503 · buildings of unknown status (outside the observed floor): 92%
Motorable road in mask: 11.8 km (range 6.4–22.0) · bridges exposed (not failed): 20 (range 12–30)
Settlements with no road path to a hospital: 4 (range 2–12) of 446, of 305 assessable; 141 settlements had no pre-flood route (not assessed)
Range = detector thresholds low/base/high × mask ±1 px × bridge policy.
Flood-like change (0.31 km² of water-like backscatter change) and surface change (2.29 km² dark, 0.54 km² bright) are each separable from all four pre-event nulls. An independent single-date water model could not separate the event from pre-event dates, and Sentinel-2 does not confirm open water.
Sentinel-2: 12% of the floor clear after the event, status null_not_calibrated; excluded.
EMSR927 GRA products held locally (checked 2026-10-11) contain landslide polygons and damage points, no flood-extent layer. EMS data is used for checking only.
Flood path within the study area — main stem: 89.6 km, 20 settlements on the corridor (geometry only); tributary: 81.5 km, 18 settlements on the corridor (geometry only).
■ flood-like (water-like backscatter change) ■ dark change ■ bright change ■ radar-unobservable
Flagged pixels are drawn 2 px wider so they are visible; every number uses the true mask.
